ancestry-dwarf.markdown:
# Dwarf

*Stone, craft, stubborn loyalty and a memory for debts both kind and cruel.*

## Rules

Choose two of the five traits below. These are invitations to a familiar fantasy,
not a required personality. Any ancestry may grow up in any culture.

**Starting values:** HP +4; base Speed 5.

- [Stubborn as Bedrock](trait-dwarf-deep-constitution.md) — Your ancestors did not dig a home from the mountain by yielding politely.
- [The Mountain Remembers](trait-dwarf-stone-reader.md) — You know a mason’s lie by the stone around it.
- [Rooted in Stone](trait-dwarf-low-center.md) — Let the storm waste its strength on you.
- [An Honest Maker’s Hand](trait-dwarf-maker-s-eye.md) — Your thumb finds the seam; your ear knows the ring of sound metal.
- [A Grudge Well Kept](trait-dwarf-carved-history.md) — You remember who struck first. You intend them to remember what followed.

**Starting coin contribution:** +2 coins. See [starting coins](../starting-coins.md).

class-warden.markdown:
# Warden

*You read the broken fern, the distant cry and the turn of a fleeing creature. When the road ends, your companions look to you.*

## Rules

**Agreed concept:** wilderness guide, tracker and hunter. Nature magic and animal companions are optional shared purchases, not required class features.

**Class foundations:** minimum 0 in Fortitude and Knowledge; HP contribution +4. No multiclassing.

**Starting disciplines:** choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Wilderness, Marksmanship, Arms, Athletics.

**Discipline pricing:** Home: Wilderness, Marksmanship. Adjacent: Arms, Athletics. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines. Use the normal sequential rank prices.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. Requirements are class and minimum level only; no discipline or earlier signature is required.

## Level 1 choices

- [Keep the Quarry Close](../cards/signature-warden-keep-the-quarry-close.md)
- [Read the Passing](../cards/signature-warden-read-the-passing.md)
- [Follow My Footsteps](../cards/signature-warden-follow-my-footsteps.md)

## Level 3 choices

- [Stay on the Scent](../cards/signature-warden-stay-on-the-scent.md)
- [Through Bramble and Stone](../cards/signature-warden-through-bramble-and-stone.md)
- [A Watchful Rest](../cards/signature-warden-a-watchful-rest.md)

## Level 7 choices

- [Turn the Hunt](../cards/signature-warden-turn-the-hunt.md)
- [Bring Them Through](../cards/signature-warden-bring-them-through.md)
- [Know What You Hunt](../cards/signature-warden-know-what-you-hunt.md)

## The character at the table

A hunter closes distance after a shot or a sword stroke. A tracker reads actual evidence. A guide gives companions a route they can use now. All three approaches remain available at each milestone; there are no locked subclasses.

Fortitude and Knowledge express endurance and understanding. Agility remains valuable to an archer, but the class does not demand one weapon or one attack attribute. +4 HP places its contribution beside Blade and Leader, below Protector and Unbalanced.


**Starting coin contribution:** +2 coins. See [starting coins](../starting-coins.md).
